actions.action: Move plant out of direct sun (a metre back from window or use a sheer curtain)
Slide plant out of pot and check roots
If roots are mushy/brown/smelly, trim them and repot in fresh well-draining soil in a pot with drainage holes
Empty the outer decorative pot after watering
Water thoroughly once the top 2–5 cm of soil is dry
Inspect leaf joints and stem for mealybugs, removing them with an alcohol-dipped cotton swab
Trim fully brown or dead leaves at the base

reason: The answer mentions letting the plant dry out as one cause among several but leads with sun stress and stresses root rot. The thorough-watering fix is present but buried. Nothing it recommends is likely to harm the plant.
